title: probeScope mislabels thrown ACCESS_DENIED as transient → scans stuck IN_PROGRESS in prod
description:
SYMPTOM
Prod scans compute findings but never finalize — stuck at IN_PROGRESS. Confirmed live 2026-07-01: scan cmr2ndfe60001mq01mk3zo4ic on nw-dev-store-2 logged 'theme scan complete' (45 findings, 291 files) but status=IN_PROGRESS, completedAt=null. Inngest fn 'scan-theme' failed + retried on:
  TransientScopeCheckError: [scope-check] transient error while probing 'read_translations' scope: Access denied for shopLocales field. Required access: read_locales or read_markets_home.

ROOT CAUSE
app/lib/scope-check.server.ts probeScope() classifies ACCESS_DENIED (→ return false, skip audit → PARTIAL) vs transient (→ throw TransientScopeCheckError → Inngest retry) ONLY for errors in the GraphQL RESPONSE BODY (json.errors). But the @shopify/shopify-app-react-router admin.graphql() client THROWS a GraphqlQueryError when the response contains errors (stack: throwFailedRequest → NewGraphqlClient.request → admin.graphql → probeScope). So access-denied lands in the catch(err) block, which UNCONDITIONALLY throws TransientScopeCheckError without running isAccessDeniedError. A permanent access-denied is thus mislabeled transient → Inngest retries forever → scan never finalizes.

IMPACT (high)
Affects every optional-scope audit (translations/products/content/redirects — all use probeScope) when the scope is un-granted AND the client throws. App runs limited scopes (read_themes-centric), so optional scopes are typically un-granted → most/all prod scans fail to finalize despite computing findings. Core feature broken in prod.

FIX
In probeScope's catch(err): run the thrown error through isAccessDeniedError (check err.message, and any structured GraphQL errors on err.body/err.response/err.graphQLErrors if present) BEFORE defaulting to transient. If access-denied → return false (skip cleanly → PARTIAL). Else → throw TransientScopeCheckError. The thrown message 'Access denied for shopLocales field...' matches the existing ACCESS_DENIED_MESSAGE regex, so message-based detection covers this case; also check extensions.code==='ACCESS_DENIED' on structured errors if the client exposes them.
TEST: mock admin.graphql to THROW a GraphqlQueryError-shaped access-denied → expect probeScope returns false (not throws). Keep existing body-errors path tests.

NOTE: worker offload (GC-8uw) verified working in the same run — this bug is unrelated to that. Stuck scan cmr2ndfe finalized to PARTIAL manually as a one-off.
close_reason: Fixed probeScope catch block (app/lib/scope-check.server.ts) to classify thrown access-denied via isAccessDeniedError (checks err.body.errors.graphQLErrors structured errors + err.message) → returns false (skip audit → PARTIAL) instead of mislabeling as transient. Root cause: @shopify/shopify-api admin.graphql THROWS GraphqlQueryError on GraphQL errors, so access-denied reached the catch and was unconditionally thrown as transient → infinite Inngest retry → scan stuck IN_PROGRESS → watchdog-FAILED. 14 scope-check tests (incl. new thrown-access-denied + thrown-transient cases) + full suite 1688 green; typecheck clean. title: Expiring offline access token → authenticate.admin bounce loop (potential merchant lockout)
description:
SYMPTOM
Embedded app hangs indefinitely on App Bridge 'Handling response'; the /app loader never renders. authenticate.admin(request) never returns — it throws a reauth bounce every request, so the app re-enters the loader in a tight loop.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed in dev, 2026-07-01)
The shop had ONE offline Session row (offline_<shop>) that was present but EXPIRED. shopify.server.ts sets future.expiringOfflineAccessTokens: true (in place since initial scaffold 3a92dac, 2026-03-10 — Shopify template default). With an expired-but-present offline token, authenticate.admin does NOT detect it as invalid and refresh it — it keeps logging 'Authenticating admin request' without ever reaching 'No valid session found' / 'Creating new session', and never returns.

EVIDENCE
- Temp breadcrumb logging in app._index.tsx loader: 'loader entered' printed every request; the line immediately AFTER authenticate.admin never printed → hang is inside authenticate.admin.
- Session row: expires=2026-07-01T16:17:17Z; measured ~19,602s (~5.4h) past expiry at repro time.
- Manual fix: deleted the Session row (prisma.session.deleteMany where shop). Next load logged the HAPPY path — 'No valid session found' → 'Requesting offline access token' → 'Creating new session' — and the dashboard rendered. So the NO-session path works; only the EXPIRED-but-present path loops.

RISK
If the same expired-but-present path loops in production, ANY merchant whose offline token expires gets a silent lockout (app hangs on 'Handling response', no error surfaced). Solo-dev app is Live; impact unconfirmed but potentially P1.

INVESTIGATE
1. Reproduce under prod-like conditions (real domain, @shopify/shopify-app-react-router v1.1.0) — does authenticate.admin loop on an expired offline token, or refresh cleanly?
2. Determine intended SDK behavior for expiring offline tokens: should authenticate.admin auto-exchange when the stored token is expired? Is there a version/config gap?
3. Decide fix: (a) proper expiry handling / auto-refresh, (b) proactively delete expired sessions before auth, or (c) reconsider enabling expiringOfflineAccessTokens if refresh isn't reliable.

MANUAL WORKAROUND (ops)
Delete the offline Session row for the affected shop → forces a clean token exchange on next load.

PRIORITY: P2 now; escalate to P1 if prod merchant impact is confirmed in step 1.
close_reason: Fixed via SafeSessionStorage guard (app/lib/safe-session-storage.server.ts), wired in shopify.server.ts. loadSession returns undefined for offline+expired(5min buffer)+no-refreshToken sessions → forces clean token exchange instead of the reauth loop. 10 unit tests (happy paths + bug case + delegation) pass; full suite 1684 green; typecheck clean. Commit f4c903d. Root cause was a legacy NULL-refreshToken offline session (0 remain in prod; refresh verified working for sessions that have a refreshToken). Owner smoke-test rolled to GC-l7u #5.

- Option C: run Inngest functions in a separate worker process/service. Correct long-term architecture but a deploy-topology change ENTANGLED with the owner-gated Railway deploy.
